verdicts.claim: Every honest give — the hand-out and every trade — is recorded, and afterwards each card’s owner in the registry is the last buyer it was given to.
verdicts.saw: 3037 of 3037 honest gives recorded; 999 of 999 cards owned by their last buyer

verdicts.claim: Every attempted double sale is refused, naming the event where the second chain parts from the first recorded one; the first buyer keeps the card.
verdicts.saw: 300 of 300 double sales refused; the first buyer kept the card 300 times

verdicts.claim: Every give signed by someone who does not own the card is refused.
verdicts.saw: 100 of 100 gives signed by a non-owner refused

verdicts.claim: The whole registry log, replayed from nothing, gives the very same cards, owners and head.
verdicts.saw: 4037 entries replayed from nothing: the very same registry

verdicts.claim: The mind goes with the card: for 50 traded cards, the mind their new owner expresses scores exactly the GATE the drop declared.
verdicts.saw: 50 of 50 traded cards’ minds scored their declared GATE for their new owner

verdicts.claim: Replaying the whole log from nothing takes at most 120 seconds on the measuring machine.
